Maya Chen: Planning a small console UI deploy tonight at 22:00 PT (in ~45m). Can someone take primary smoke and watch metrics? I'll handle CDN purge/warm. Plan: canary -> smoke -> purge -> cache warm -> full rollout. Rollback tag: release/ui-20260317-quickfix. Any conflicts?
Alex Park: I can take primary for the window. Will run the smoke script and validate routes. Ping me when the canary is up.
Jon Rivera: I'll monitor SLOs and tracing, standing by for rollback. Which endpoints should I focus on for smoke?
Maya Chen: Smoke script is scripts/ui_smoke.sh (checks /, /api/status, auth flows). Target asset load <300ms. Run like:
```bash
./scripts/ui_smoke.sh --canary-url https://canary.console.redwood.ai
```
Alex Park: Ack. I'll also do a local cache-bust to confirm asset hash changes.
deploy-bot: Deployment pipeline queued: pipelines/ui-deploy-1767777777. Stages: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Est. duration 4m.
SRE Oncall: I'll keep pager open. What's the explicit rollback procedure and artifact name?
Maya Chen: Rollback command (k8s):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/console console=redwood/console:release/ui-20260317-quickfix -n prod
```
CDN purge (Fastly):
```bash
fastly purge --service 123abc --url "https://console.redwood.ai/*"
```
Alex Park: After canary passes I'll run the purge and then run cache-warmup (prefetch top routes). I'll post timestamps. :thumbsup: 
Jon Rivera: I'll watch 99th pct latency, error rate, and traces for 5m after each stage.
Maya Chen: Will post a go/no-go 10m prior. Thanks.
Alex Park: 👍
SRE Oncall: 👍
Maya Chen: Go to start: :rocket:
Alex Park: Starting canary now. Posting logs to #deploy-logs.
deploy-bot: Canary step completed. Canary health OK -> progressing to 50%.
Alex Park: 50% looks clean, proceeding to 100%.
deploy-bot: Deployment finished successfully.
Maya Chen: Running Fastly purge now.
Alex Park: Cache warmup done (prefetched /, /admin, /api/status). Assets returning 200 and load times improved.
Jon Rivera: Metrics look good. No uptick in errors or latency.
Maya Chen: Closing the window. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. :tada:
